plan: This is a second-price auction where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy. Since I pay the second-highest bid if I win (not my own bid), there's no benefit to shading my bid down, and bidding above my value risks paying more than the item is worth to me. My value is $48, so I should bid exactly $48 to maximize expected profit while ensuring I never overpay relative to my valuation.

This is a second-price auction, where bidding your true value is the dominant strategy regardless of what others bid. If I bid exactly my value ($38), I guarantee that whenever I win, I pay less than my value (profit), and I never overpay since I only pay the second-highest bid. Bidding higher risks paying more than my value if others bid between my true value and my inflated bid. Bidding lower risks losing profitable opportunities. Therefore, I will bid my true value of $38.
